Natural Language Generation(NLG) aims to produces Natural Language based on various input like meaning representations or numeric data.

Following the evaluation approach in early work , SimpleNLG-TI is evaluated by comparing its output with a golden standard. When an output is completely identical with the golden standard, then we take SimpleNLG-TI passes this unit test.
SimpleNLG-TI has successfully passed all 84 unit tests, which cover Tibetan linguistic features previous described in this paper.
